description: This file defines a Doctrine ORM entity class 'OpenIdProvider' that maps to the 'ohrm_openid_provider' database table. It includes properties corresponding to database columns such as 'id', 'provider_name', 'provider_url', and 'status', with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OpenIdProvider
classes.description: An entity class representing OpenID providers for authentication, with fields for provider name, URL, status, and an auto-generated ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the provider.

methods.name: setProviderName
methods.description: Sets the name of the provider.

methods.name: getProviderUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the provider.

methods.name: setProviderUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the provider.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the provider (active/inactive).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the provider.
